## Objective
- Build a complete, playable chess website with puzzles and game analysis, including support for Chess.com games.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a dark-themed chess studio named Endgame.
- Implemented a lightweight in-browser chess search engine and local heuristic review; no positions or moves are intentionally sent to a server.
- Chess.com URL import attempts direct fetch, with PGN paste/upload as fallback when browser CORS blocks access.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `index.html` with Play, Puzzles, and Analyze views.
- Added `styles.css` with responsive styling.
- Started implementing chess gameplay, local engine, puzzles, and PGN analysis in `app.js`.

### Active
- Finish and validate `app.js`; it is currently incomplete. It was overwritten after a browser check revealed `ReferenceError: $$ is not defined` and `ReferenceError: gameOver is not defined`; current contents only include definitions through `playSound()`.
- Implement the missing puzzle data/handlers, navigation, PGN analysis/import, event listeners, clock functions, and initial rendering.
- Run syntax and browser checks, fix runtime issues, and capture a small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Browser check was initially blocked because Chromium was not installed; installation succeeded. No current blocker.

## Next Move
1. Continue `app.js` from its current end, implementing the missing functions and UI event handlers (previously drafted versions are not present in the current file).
2. Run `node --check app.js` and test the site in Playwright, including game, puzzle, and sample-PGN analysis flows.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; report any remaining limitations.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: App structure and views.
- `styles.css`: Responsive visual design.
- `app.js`: Chess engine and interactive functionality; currently incomplete.

## Important Context
- `index.html` imports Chess.js from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chess.js@1.4.0/+esm`.
- The local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright opened `http://localhost:3002`; prior console errors were `ReferenceError: $$ is not defined` and `ReferenceError: gameOver is not defined`. These arose from a later script overwrite; current `app.js` defines both symbols at the top, but its remaining implementation is absent.
- Changes are uncommitted.

- Build a complete, playable chess website with puzzles and game analysis, including support for Chess.com games.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a dark-themed chess studio named Endgame with Play, Puzzles, and Analyze views.
- Use an in-browser chess search engine and local heuristic review; no positions or moves are intentionally sent to a server.
- Chess.com URL import may be blocked by browser CORS; PGN paste/upload is the fallback.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added responsive interface in `index.html` and `styles.css`.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable chess website with puzzles and game analysis, including Chess.com game support.
- Expand it with a progress ranking system, an AI Coach, opening courses, and many endgame puzzles.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.
- Add a ranking system to track improvement, an AI Coach, opening courses, and many endgame puzzles.

## Decisions
- The site is a dark-themed chess studio named Endgame with Play, Puzzles, and Analyze views.
- Gameplay uses an in-browser chess search engine and local heuristic review; positions and moves are not intentionally sent to a server.
- PGN paste/upload is the fallback for Chess.com games because browser CORS may prevent URL import.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built responsive Play, Puzzles, and Analyze views, including local-engine gameplay, board interaction, promotion, undo/hints, clocks, four puzzles, PGN upload/paste/sample loading, and heuristic review.

- Captured and inspected `/tmp/opencode/endgame-latest.jpg` at 1280×900.

### Active
- Add ranking/progress tracking, an AI Coach, opening courses, and a larger set of endgame puzzles.
- Continue validating the site and address issues found during testing.

### Blocked
- Chess.com URL import is not implemented; URL lines are discarded by PGN parsing, so users currently need to paste or upload PGN.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the existing UI and app structure, then implement the requested ranking, coaching, opening-course, and endgame-puzzle features.
2. Fix or clarify Chess.com URL handling and the PGN-only fallback.
3. Re-run syntax and browser-flow checks; capture and inspect a fresh JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Engine gameplay, puzzle data and interactions, PGN parsing, and analysis.
- `index.html`: Endgame interface and view elements.
- `styles.css`: Responsive layout and visual styling.

- Changes are uncommitted; repository files are currently untracked.
- The app was available at `http://localhost:3002`; a favicon request returned `404 (File not found)`.
- Analysis results explicitly describe evaluations as local material-and-position heuristics, not grandmaster annotations.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable chess website with puzzles and game analysis, including Chess.com game support.
- Add local progress ranking, an AI Coach, opening courses, and many endgame puzzles.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- The site is a dark-themed chess studio named Endgame with Play, Puzzles, Analyze, Progress, AI Coach, and Courses views.
- Gameplay, coaching suggestions, and analysis use in-browser chess logic; progress is stored locally.
- Chess.com game URLs are not imported directly; PGN paste/upload remains the fallback because browser CORS may prevent URL import.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built responsive Play, Puzzles, and Analyze views, including local-engine gameplay, board interaction, promotion, undo/hints, clocks, PGN upload/paste/sample loading, and heuristic review.
- Added local rating and session-history view, puzzle/lesson counters, and reset-progress action.
- Added local position-coaching view with candidate-move, threat, and plan prompts.
- Added 10 opening-course starter lessons and 12 generated rook-endgame positions.
- `node --check app.js` passes; `http://localhost:3002` returns HTTP 200.
- Opened the app in Playwright and confirmed the main page and six navigation views render. The only reported console error was a missing `/favicon.ico` (404).

### Active
- Validate Progress, AI Coach, Courses, localStorage persistence, endgame puzzle solutions, and rating updates in a browser.
- Fix timeout result recording and any other issues found.
- Capture and inspect a fresh JPEG screenshot no wider than 1280px; check responsive layout.

### Blocked
- Chess.com URL import is not implemented; users currently need to paste or upload PGN.
- Timeout outcomes are not recorded in progress.

## Next Move
1. Test the new views, persistence, endgame puzzle solutions, and game result/rating behavior in Playwright.
2. Record timeout results and fix any discovered issues.
3. Re-run syntax checks, then capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Game engine, puzzle data, progress persistence/rating, coaching, courses, and PGN analysis.
- `index.html`: Navigation and view markup.
- `styles.css`: Responsive styling for the studio and new views.

## Important Context
- Earlier browser checks verified a puzzle solution, sample PGN review (125 half-moves), and gameplay responding to `1. e4` with `1...e5`.
- Analysis evaluations are local material-and-position heuristics, not grandmaster annotations.
- Changes remain uncommitted; repository files are untracked.
